component.name: Eternal Lands
component.summary: A free to play, graphical MMORPG

description.p: Eternal Lands is a free-to-play, 3D fantasy MMORPG (massively multiplayer online role-playing game) compatible with Windows, Android, Linux, and macOS

The game features 12 unique skills: Attack, Defence, Harvest, Alchemy, Magic, Potion, Summoning, Manufacturing, Crafting, Engineering, Tailoring, and Ranging. Because there are no fixed class restrictions, you have total freedom to develop your character however you choose.

You can easily adjust your build at any time if you make a mistake or want to try a new strategy.Eternal Lands goes far beyond traditional combat. Many players prefer peaceful activities like harvesting resources, crafting items, and summoning monsters. However, if you enjoy fighting, the game offers plenty of both PvP (player versus player) and PvE (player versus environment) content.
The game is owned and operated by Radu Privantu, while this specific package is built and maintained by "bluap", one of the client developers.
